descriptions.calendars_list: List calendar entities that this token can access, so an agent can select a calendar before retrieving or changing its events.
descriptions.calendars_list-events: Retrieve events from one calendar entity during the required start and end time window; use this to inspect scheduling conflicts or upcoming commitments.
descriptions.components_list: List integrations currently loaded by this Home Assistant instance to diagnose availability and choose supported capabilities.
descriptions.config_validate: Ask Home Assistant to validate its configuration before a reload or restart, returning server-side syntax and setup errors.
descriptions.error-log_get: Retrieve the current Home Assistant error log for diagnosing failing integrations, automations, and service calls.
descriptions.events_fire: Fire the required named Home Assistant event with an optional JSON body, for testing automations or notifying event listeners.
descriptions.events_list: List the event types currently exposed by Home Assistant before subscribing to or firing an event.
descriptions.intent_handle: Send a natural-language request to Home Assistant Assist and return the resolved intent response for the configured conversation agent.
descriptions.services_list: List callable Home Assistant service domains and actions so an agent can validate a service before issuing a mutation.
descriptions.states_get: Retrieve one live entity state and attributes by the required entity ID, suitable for checking a device before taking action.
descriptions.states_list: List all current entity states and attributes for inventory, filtering, and state-based household analysis.
descriptions.template_render: Render a Home Assistant Jinja template against the live state machine to safely inspect a computed value before automation use.
